description: The shared preset owns the temporary npm 12 allow-remote workaround (npm/cli#9800); remove that workaround from the shared source when Mend includes npm/cli#9819. forkProcessing stays here because fork admission happens before preset resolution.
Every npm update rebuilds the committed dist/ package, so separate PRs conflict with each other after each merge. One weekly group needs one rebuild.

CI must build dist/ on the Node major GitHub's runner uses for JavaScript actions (action.yml `using: node24`); the shipped node-libcurl binary only loads on the Node that built it, and tooling/smoke-packaged-curl.cjs enforces the match. Move CI Node, action.yml and node-libcurl together in one PR once the runner runs node26 actions.
